verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is a single-purpose Agent Skill (a SKILL.md folder plus Python tools) for producing logo concepts and brand kits. A user-configurable rule engine that triggers actions on events is outside this product category. Its built-in self-audit before showing drafts and the host agent picking the skill up from its description are fixed workflow and host-platform behaviours, not user-defined event rules, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
